note: Sri Lanka: every visitor needs an Electronic Travel Authorization, 30 days (free since 25 May 2026 for the 40 countries the Department lists, Singapore and Seychelles; USD 20 for SAARC and USD 50 for everyone else, not modelled), Maldivians 90 days; nationals of Cameroon, Ghana, Côte d'Ivoire, Kosovo, Nigeria, North Korea, Syria and Taiwan can't apply alone and need a visa through a Sri Lankan sponsor (that list read from Wikipedia's copy). Hong Kong and Macao passports apply as China.

sources.title: Department of Immigration and Emigration (Sri Lanka), ETA fees
sources.said: With effect from 25.05.2026, nationals of the following 40 countries are eligible to obtain tourist visa (ETA) free-of-charge for a period of 30 days. ... As per the reciprocal and Bilateral agreements following countries are also eligible to obtain tourist visa (ETA) free of charge Singapore and Seychelles - 30 days ... ETA charges for all other countries apply as mentioned below.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Sri Lanka
sources.said: Most visitors to Sri Lanka must obtain an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA). ... 90 days Maldives ... When applying for an ETA, visitors with these passports should select China as nationality because Hong Kong / Macau is not available as a nationality option. ... Citizens of the following countries can not apply for ETA independently. They must obtain a visa through a Sri Lankan sponsor: Cameroon Ghana Ivory Coast Kosovo Nigeria North Korea Syria Taiwan
